descriptions.description:
This dataset contains the structured legal research materials underlying the article “Rethinking EU Environmental Law: Towards the Ecologisation of the European Legal Order”. It brings together the legal and institutional sources examined in the article to support the analysis of the development of ecocentric approaches within the European Union legal order.

The materials include relevant provisions of EU primary law, secondary legislation, case law of the Court of Justice of the European Union, institutional documents and European Citizens’ Initiatives, where applicable. The sources are organised to facilitate their identification, traceability and consultation, and to make the legal materials underpinning the article’s analysis more transparent and reusable.

The sources are drawn from publicly available legal and institutional repositories, including EUR-Lex and the official websites of EU institutions. The dataset is intended to support the verification and further study of the legal sources discussed in the article. It does not contain personal data.
EU primary law, EU secondary legislation, CJEU case law, EU institutional documents, environmental policy documents, academic literature and other relevant legal and documentary sources.
Legal, institutional, policy and academic sources concerning EU environmental law, ecocentrism, ecological justice, protection of nature and the ecologisation of the European legal order.

The sources underlying the research are identified in the associated publication and in the research materials deposited with the dataset, where applicable. Access to third-party materials remains subject to the copyright, licensing and access conditions applicable to the original sources.
